price_why: It hands me a ready slide plan for a post only my gym client can make, plus three ranked follow-ups, and it tells me exactly what to ask the setters for. But I'd still have to write every hook and caption line myself, so it isn't worth $49.
one_line: A researched brief that recommends a four-slide 'same grade tag, different problem' carousel built on the setter's notes, then adds three ranked, cross-niche carousel adaptations for members and first-timers.
strongest: The lead post uses something only this gym has (its setters' words on two same-tag problems), has a clear slide plan and cover, and lists how it could fail, including reading as defensive about grades.
weakest: Hooks are given only as 'shapes' and never written, and nearly every post needs setter or staff input the creator has to go and get, so none can be made without another round with the gym.
